nodes.name: PreviewAnalysisService.cs
nodes.summary: Implements real-time audio preview analysis: decodes a preview URL stream, applies FFT with a Hann window, and emits per-frame amplitude data over a callback for waveform visualization.

nodes.name: PreviewAnalysisService
nodes.summary: Manages preview audio decode sessions, running FFT-based frequency-bucket analysis and sending animation frames via a delegate; supports concurrent session replacement and async disposal.

nodes.name: Program.cs
nodes.summary: Entry point for the Wavee.AudioHost out-of-process audio runtime: parses CLI args, configures Serilog, builds a generic host, and starts the named-pipe IPC server for communication with the WinUI process.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Developer reference for the out-of-process audio runtime: explains the x64-only process model, named-pipe IPC protocol, audio decode stack, folder layout, PlayPlay key emulator, and build/run instructions.

nodes.name: Wavee.AudioHost.csproj
nodes.summary: MSBuild project file for the x64-only audio host process, configuring .NET 10 target, x64 platform constraint, NuGet references, and source-include of IpcMessages.cs from Wavee.Playback.Contracts.

nodes.name: ConnectConsole.cs
nodes.summary: Full-featured interactive Spotify Connect console controller: handles playback commands (play, pause, seek, skip), library sync, playlist browsing, search, device and volume management, and reactive Dealer/playback event subscriptions.

nodes.name: ConnectConsole
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the CLI Spotify session: wires playback pipeline, library service, Rx event subscriptions, and delegates user input commands to specialized async handlers.

nodes.name: Program.cs
nodes.summary: Entry point for the AOT-compiled CLI client: configures Serilog with Spectre sink, establishes a Spotify Session with OAuth, and starts the ConnectConsole interactive loop.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Overview of the AOT CLI client: what it does, its four source files, run/publish commands, and dependency list (Spectre.Console, Serilog, System.Reactive).

nodes.name: SpectreLogSink.cs
nodes.summary: Serilog sink adapter that routes log events into the SpectreUI in-memory log queue, plus an ILoggerSinkConfiguration extension method for fluent registration.

nodes.name: SpectreUI.cs
nodes.summary: Terminal UI for the CLI client using Spectre.Console: maintains a live-rendered dashboard with now-playing panel, seek/volume bars, lyrics pane, device/dealer status, and a scrolling log, plus keyboard input handling.

nodes.name: SpectreUI
nodes.summary: Renders a full terminal dashboard via Spectre.Console with thread-safe state updates, virtual-terminal processing, and async render/input loops.

nodes.name: Wavee.Console.csproj
nodes.summary: MSBuild project for the AOT-capable CLI client, enabling PublishAot and NativeAOT-compatible packages (Spectre.Console, Serilog), with references to Wavee and Wavee.UI.

nodes.name: HSVColor.cs
nodes.summary: Minimal record/struct defining HSV color components (hue, saturation, value) used in the palette generation pipeline.

nodes.name: IPaletteGenrator.cs
nodes.summary: Interface contract for palette generators that produce a PaletteResult from an image source, used for album-art-driven lyric background theming.

nodes.name: IThemeColorGenrator.cs
nodes.summary: Interface contract for theme color generators that extract a dominant or vibrant color from an image for dynamic UI theming in the lyrics control.

nodes.name: PaletteResult.cs
nodes.summary: Data transfer records PaletteResult and ThemeColorResult that carry extracted palette swatches, darkness flags, and the dominant theme color from album artwork analysis.

nodes.name: CMap.cs
nodes.summary: Color map data structure holding quantized VBox entries, providing palette generation, nearest-color lookup, and vibrant/muted color search by luma and saturation target ranges.

nodes.name: CMap
nodes.summary: Stores quantized color buckets and exposes palette generation, nearest-color matching, and FindColor for targeted vibrant/muted swatch selection.

nodes.name: Color.cs
nodes.summary: RGBA color struct for the ColorThief library with HSL conversion, hex-string serialization, and luminance helpers used during palette extraction.

nodes.name: ColorThief.cs
nodes.summary: Core ColorThief class providing pixel array quantization via MMCQ to extract dominant color palettes from raw pixel data.

nodes.name: ColorThief
nodes.summary: Provides GetColorMap and ConvertPixels to transform raw RGBA pixel arrays into quantized CMap color palettes using MMCQ.

nodes.name: ColorThief.WinUI3.cs
nodes.summary: WinUI 3 partial extension of ColorThief adding GetColor and GetPalette methods that decode a SoftwareBitmap via BitmapDecoder into pixel data for quantization.
nodes.languageNotes: Partial class pattern extends ColorThief.cs for WinUI-specific BitmapDecoder pixel extraction.

nodes.name: HslColor.cs
nodes.summary: Simple HSL color record carrying hue, saturation, and lightness values used in the palette luma/saturation scoring pipeline.

nodes.name: Mmcq.cs
nodes.summary: Modified Median Cut Quantization (MMCQ) algorithm implementation: histogramming, VBox splitting with DoCut/MedianCutApply, iterative refinement via Iter, and the public Quantize entry point.

nodes.name: Mmcq
nodes.summary: Implements the MMCQ color quantization algorithm: builds a histogram, creates VBoxes, applies median cuts, and returns a sorted CMap palette for a given pixel array.

nodes.name: QuantizedColor.cs
nodes.summary: QuantizedColor result type pairing a Color with its pixel population count and a computed YIQ luma-based darkness flag.

nodes.name: VBox.cs
nodes.summary: VBox (color volume box) used by MMCQ to represent a 3D RGB sub-cube with pixel count, average color, containment check, and IComparer implementations for sorted splitting.

nodes.name: VBox
nodes.summary: Represents a 3-dimensional RGB color volume bucket with lazy-computed pixel count, average color calculation, and clone support for MMCQ median-cut splitting.

nodes.name: App.cs
nodes.summary: Static constants class holding application metadata for the lyrics control library: author names, app name, startup task ID, and Store ID.

nodes.name: ExtendedGenreFiled.cs
nodes.summary: Constants for extended ID3-like genre field keys: NetEase Cloud Music track ID, QQ Music track ID, and file name fields used in lyrics metadata lookups.

nodes.name: Wiki82.profile.xml
nodes.summary: NTextCat language identification ngram profile (Wikipedia 82-language model) used for lyrics language detection in the controls library.
